Name: Turnkey for T3 Code
Author: Alejandro Martinez
Description: Watch and steer T3 Code threads from Stream Deck: thread status, stop, prompts, model options and answers, across every provider.

Actions.Name: Thread
Actions.Tooltip: One thread from the board, filled by key position: status, title and timer. Tap opens it in T3 Code; hold selects it.

Actions.Name: Activity
Actions.Tooltip: The most urgent thread matching a filter. Tap opens it in T3 Code.

Actions.Name: New Thread
Actions.Tooltip: Starts a new thread in the selected thread's project, no project, or a chosen one; with a saved prompt or empty.

Actions.Name: Send Prompt
Actions.Tooltip: Sends your own prompt, or an everyday one (continue, fix tests, explain, commit…), to the selected thread. Hold to interrupt and restart with it.

Actions.Name: Steer
Actions.Tooltip: Adds a saved instruction to the selected thread's running turn.

Actions.Name: Run Skill
Actions.Tooltip: Runs one of the thread's provider skills, the way picking it in T3 Code's composer and sending does.

Actions.Name: Stop
Actions.Tooltip: Stops the selected thread's running turn, or the workflows it runs (Claude), as its Stops setting picks. Hold to stop a workflow.

Actions.Name: Model
Actions.Tooltip: Switches the selected thread to a favorite model, or to the next of T3 Code's favorites.

Actions.Name: Effort
Actions.Tooltip: Sets the selected thread's reasoning effort, or steps through what its model offers.

Actions.Name: Speed
Actions.Tooltip: Toggles fast mode on the selected thread where its model offers it.

Actions.Name: Permissions
Actions.Tooltip: Sets the selected thread's access, from Supervised to Full access, or steps through them.

Actions.Name: Plan
Actions.Tooltip: Switches the selected thread between Build and Plan.

Actions.Name: Approve
Actions.Tooltip: Answers the selected thread's approval as far as its settings allow, or opens it in T3 Code.

Actions.Name: Deny
Actions.Tooltip: Declines the selected thread's approval.

Actions.Name: Organize
Actions.Tooltip: Settles, pins, snoozes, archives or marks the selected thread unread, or wakes the thread snoozed last.

Actions.Name: Fork
Actions.Tooltip: Forks the thread from its newest finished reply and opens the fork, or merges a fork back into the thread it came from (hold).

Actions.Name: Branch
Actions.Tooltip: The selected thread's branch. Tap opens the thread in T3 Code.

Actions.Name: Git
Actions.Tooltip: Commits, pushes, creates a PR or pulls the selected thread's branch, as its Action setting picks. Hold to push.

Actions.Name: Pull Request
Actions.Tooltip: The selected thread's pull request and its state; tap opens it. Or hands it to an agent: fix findings (hold), explain, ask, or a review guide.

Actions.Name: Run Task
Actions.Tooltip: One of T3 Code's scheduled tasks: its name and when it runs next. Press runs it now.

Actions.Name: Usage
Actions.Tooltip: A period's API-estimate cost, tokens and sessions, as T3 Code's Usage shows them, on one machine or all. Tap refreshes; hold also reloads model prices.

Actions.Name: Limits
Actions.Tooltip: A provider's subscription limit, pooled like T3 Code's Limits: % left, next reset and banked resets. Tap refreshes; hold opens T3 Code's Usage or uses a reset.

Actions.Name: Open
Actions.Tooltip: Opens the selected thread's worktree in an editor, or its preview page in this computer's browser, as its In setting picks.

Actions.Name: Health
Actions.Tooltip: The connection to T3 Code and its providers: the worst problem first (offline, needs pairing, not authenticated, unsupported version, unavailable). Tap reconnects.

Actions.Name: Update T3
Actions.Tooltip: T3 Code's version on a machine. Hold updates it to the newest release; needs update access, asked for at that machine's next pairing.

Actions.Name: Run Script
Actions.Tooltip: Runs one of the project's saved scripts in the thread's terminal; hold stops it. Needs terminal access (shell), asked for at that machine's next pairing.

Actions.Name: Share Thread
Actions.Tooltip: Makes a guest link for the thread and copies it; shows Shared and its guest. Hold stops sharing. Needs guest link access, asked for at that machine's next pairing.

Actions.Name: Threads Dial
Actions.Tooltip: Rotate through the threads that match its filter, selecting them in T3 Code; press or tap to open one.

Actions.Name: Power Dial
Actions.Tooltip: Changes the selected thread's model, effort or access; press or tap switches Speed where offered.

Actions.Name: Prompts Dial
Actions.Tooltip: Rotate through your prompts and templates. Press sends to the selected thread; hold starts a new thread.

Actions.Name: Answer Dial
Actions.Tooltip: Answers an agent's question choice by choice, and approvals as far as its settings allow.

Actions.Name: Queue Dial
Actions.Tooltip: Rotate through the selected thread's queued messages. Press sends one now (steering it in, or starting it while nothing runs); hold removes it.

Actions.Name: Tasks Dial
Actions.Tooltip: Rotate through T3 Code's scheduled tasks, with when each runs next. Press runs the shown task now; tap turns it off or back on.

Actions.Name: Skills Dial
Actions.Tooltip: Rotate through the thread's provider skills. Press or tap runs the shown one; touch and hold reads its description.

Actions.Name: PR Dial
Actions.Tooltip: Rotate through open pull requests. Press runs Fix findings, tap opens it in the browser, touch and hold reads its findings.

Actions.Name: Limits Dial
Actions.Tooltip: Rotate through every provider's limit windows. Press or tap refreshes; hold the press to open T3 Code's Usage or use a reset.

Actions.Name: Usage Dial
Actions.Tooltip: Rotate through a period's total and each model's cost, tokens, cache hit rate and cost per million tokens. Press or tap refreshes; a long press reloads model prices.

Actions.Name: Devices Dial
Actions.Tooltip: Rotate through T3 Code's simulators and emulators. Press starts the shown one, or opens it, in the thread's Device panel; hold powers it off. Touch looks for devices again.
